title: Puharich's theory in Beyond Telepathy of relaxed versus aroused states

tellings.quote: Puharic wrote about that in a book called beyond telepathy in in which he developed a theory that for receptive forms of ESP it's good to be relaxed

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, was a guest on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He describes a 1960s book called Beyond Telepathy by Andrija Puharich, another researcher of the subject. Mishlove says that in it Puharich argued that for receptive forms of ESP (extrasensory perception, meaning picking up information without the ordinary senses) it helps to be relaxed rather than aroused, which would mean that psychic reception depends on your state of mind and body.
